source_evidence: Regular investing means that you put a set dollar amount or a set percentage of your income into your investment accounts.
question: What does it mean to make regular investment contributions, and how can they support long-term investing?
answer: Regular contributions mean putting a set dollar amount or a set percentage of your income into investment accounts on an ongoing basis. Keeping money invested over time can allow it to benefit from compound growth. The source also notes that starting earlier gives compounding more time to work.
